chatbot.welcomeMessage: Hi! I'm your booking assistant. How can I help you today?

chatbotKnowledge.question: What is your cancellation policy?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: You can cancel your appointment up to 24 hours before the scheduled time. Please contact us or use the My Bookings page to cancel.

chatbotKnowledge.question: Can I reschedule my appointment?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: Yes, you can reschedule your appointment up to 12 hours before the scheduled time through the My Bookings page.

chatbotKnowledge.question: What payment methods do you accept?
chatbotKnowledge.answer: We accept various payment methods including online payments and pay-at-venue options. Check the booking form for available methods.
